main_design_logic: Uses the best literature motif GPGDP, repeated 3x, with Gly/Ser flexibility.
Combines original LBP GPGNP with improved GPGDP.
IDP-like flexible acidic shell around GPGDP.
Lower negative charge to avoid nonspecific Na+/Ca2+ binding.
Two GPGDP motifs plus IDP acidic spacer.
Higher Asp density for stronger Li+ capture.
